note: Recast from Emerson 1925; the original is in English. The label column of the soldier measurement rows is completely destroyed in the extracted PDF text (only the values 2.70—3.50, 1.038—1.12, .45—.48, .6—1.00, .30, .50 survive), so they cannot be matched to characters and are not recorded; the alate pronotum length is also missing from the extracted text and is likewise not recorded. The original gives the alate antennal length as 1.33—1.88.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, oval, narrow; covered with very short hairs and a few longer setae. Fontanelle very small, slit-like, forked at the end. Antenna dark, 14 segments, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 2. Eyes rather large, fairly close to the lower margin of the head; ocelli medium-sized, less than half their own length from the eye. Labrum pale. Postclypeus almost as dark as the head, large, without a median suture, posterior margin strongly curved. Pronotum almost as dark as the head, semicircular in outline, the lateral and posterior margins forming an even arc without a notch, with a series of T-shaped markings in the middle. Posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum broadly concave. Wings dark smoky, with a pale stripe between the media and the cubitus; the radial sector and the first branches of the cubitus dark. Abdominal tergites dark. Measurements (mm): body length (with wings) 8.50—9.00; body length (without wings) 5.00—6.00; head length 0.80—0.86; head width 0.64—0.69; antennal length 1.33—1.88; eye diameter 0.20; pronotum width 0.57—0.61; hind tibia 0.94—0.97; forewing length 5.69—6.40; forewing width 1.53—1.64.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, the rostrum reddish brown; lateral outline straight, slightly raised at the base of the rostrum; oval in dorsal view apart from the rostrum; covered with short hairs, with 4 shorter setae at the base of the rostrum and 2 on the vertex. Antenna 11 segments, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 2 as long as segment 4. Rostrum darker than the head, long and slender, covered with short hairs. Pronotum pale yellow. Abdominal tergites covered with short hairs, the posterior margin with a row of very short marginal setae only slightly longer than the hair covering; abdomen pale yellow.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Comparison: close to N. microsoma, but the soldier is smaller. Type locality Kartabo (British Guiana); the holotype is an alate, the morphotype a soldier; the description is based on alates from 6 colonies at that locality, one king and queen, and several soldiers.
